source.name: Authored in-house; the 50 problems of the flat multi-step-reasoning suite, re-instrumented. v1 scored the ENTIRE answer against a bare gold value under prompts that ask the model to "Solve step by step" — so it ranked output-format obedience, not reasoning: measured live 2026-09-07, or-solar-pro4 and or-gemini-flash scored 0.000 on whole-text exact and 1.000 on the extracted answer over 20 GSM8K items sent under the same prompt. v2 puts the answer-format demand on a single labelled last line and scores THAT (exact/final-number for the 37 numeric golds, exact/final-answer for the 13 that are a weekday, yes/no, a letter, a time or a fraction). Item ids are NEW (msr2-NNN): cacheKeyOf hashes the item id, not the prompt or the scoring, so reusing the v1 ids would have silently resumed v1's cells and re-certified the wrong numbers.
